cheatsheet.title: W-09 — Course tree renders in HTML tree (web)

intro.description: Validates the course tree in the web browser host page. Requires self-hosted GWT WAR and course-tree.js/css. Scripts: scenarios/S_W-09_CourseTreeWeb_CLAUDE_V1.ps1 and 03-RCP-Spike/tests/scenarios/S_W-09_CourseTreeWeb_GROK_V1.ps1. Gate: none. Spec status: NOT RUN; static prechecks PASS 15/0/4 (2026-11-01). Browser half needs WAR. Architecture: D-COURSE-01 accepted. Prefer Playwright suite (see Handoff_CLAUDE_by_GROK_V1_1.md) for automated browser evidence.

item.title: 1. Prerequisites
item.description: Scenario type: browser / web host page. Client scope: web. Confirm applicable prerequisites before starting.

subitem.label: GWT WAR built and self-hosted (GeoGebra/ directory with deployggb.js and HTML5/5.0/web3d/).
Sample course file accessible at courses/trigonometry_intro.json.

item.title: 2. Page load
item.description: Open course-host.html in Chrome or Firefox. GeoGebra applet loads (html5codebase points to local WAR). CAS readiness check completes (evalCommandCAS '1+1' returns '2').

subitem.label: Status bar shows 'Ready' after CAS check.

item.title: 3. Tree rendering
item.description: Course title in #course-title. 5 chapters with expand/collapse. Steps under each chapter with status icons.

subitem.label: ARIA roles present: role=tree, role=treeitem, aria-expanded.

item.title: 4. Step execution
item.description: Select step 1.1, click Run Step: point O appears. Select step 1.2, click Run Step: circle drawn. Status bar updates.

subitem.label: Run Step button disabled during execution, re-enabled after.

item.title: 5. Validation
item.description: After step 1.1, Check: 'O exists' shows pass icon. After step 3.3, CAS check: Pythagorean identity returns '1'.

subitem.label: Feedback text displayed in status bar.

item.title: 6. Security (subset of T-01..T-14)
item.description: Verify command allowlist blocks Execute, path traversal rejected for OPEN.

item.title: 7. Keyboard navigation (accessibility)
item.description: Arrow Up/Down moves between steps. Enter/Space runs the step. Home/End jump to first/last.

item.title: 8. Mobile responsive
item.description: At viewport width under 640px: sidebar becomes a slide-out panel with toggle button. Applet fills the viewport.

item.title: 9. Record evidence
item.description: Record date, commit, OS, browser version, course URL, expected vs actual, screenshot path. Update SCENARIOS_TRACKING.

subitem.label: Evidence follows the AGENTS.md evidence rule.
